tweet_text:
Before: Worrying if that Amazon email is a scam.
After: Asking Alexa to instantly verify it for you.

Amazon's new AI feature is a massive win against phishers. Here is how to use it: https://www.theverge.com/tech/988518/amazon-alexa-for-shopping-verify-emails
source_title: Amazon’s AI assistant can now spot fake emails from the company

decision_process.problem: People constantly fall victim to sophisticated Amazon impersonation scams via email, text, and calls.
decision_process.audience: Everyday consumers, online shoppers, and tech users who want to protect their personal data.
decision_process.benefits: Instant verification of suspicious messages, eliminating anxiety and preventing financial fraud.
decision_process.promise: You can now use Amazon's AI assistant to immediately detect and expose phishing attempts.
decision_process.emotions: Relief from scam anxiety, curiosity about how the AI works, and empowerment to fight back.
decision_process.action: Click the link to learn how to activate and use this new AI security feature.
